proposal.reason: Main change is in transport: P2P/SHM connection setup now includes host/device stream pairing, progress reporting by completed connections, CE control-buffer SHM descriptor import/export lifecycle, and collective-vs-P2P registered-address handling. Additional device-topology review is needed because topology path computation adds intra-node NET-vs-GPU bandwidth checks and a NET_DISABLE_INTRA gate that directly changes transport eligibility decisions.
